speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter of the last of August is still on the chest. The seal is the seal I set.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow is the eleventh. Hobbins will have it as it is. I am not breaking the wax to put a tooth into a letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The parcel, if there is one, can wait until I have put this into his hand. Enough.
